instruction: A candid documentary medium shot of a group of friends on a rooftop terrace. On the far left, a man with a hair bun (R5) in a black shirt stands next to a Black man with glasses (R6) in a white t-shirt who has his arm around a blonde woman (R1) in a colorful striped dress. In the center, a man in a white cap (R2) holds a cupcake with a lit candle and reaches forward. To his right, a woman in a black sleeveless top (R4) and a dark-haired woman (R3) in a striped top laugh and cheer. On the far right, a woman with a curly afro (R7) in a striped dress smiles. The scene is lit by natural daylight.
elements: R6 has his arm around R1
R1 is the person being held close by R6's arm
R2 holds a cupcake with a lit candle and reaches forward
R3 and R4 laugh and cheer while R2 presents the cupcake
